purpose: Determine whether FreeCAD's native C++ DXF importer preserves the closed state of a generated classic 3D POLYLINE.

source.provenance: Generated locally from scratch during the optional P8 integration test; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

consumer.route: FreeCAD Draft DWG open -> installed dwg2dxf -> C++ DXF importer

validation.focusedCtest: dwg2dxf_freecad_generated_ac1021_primitives_open and _insert both reach native import, then fail the expected four-edge closed shape assertion (observed 3 edges).
validation.strictPreflight: Installed converter succeeds and preserves the documented group-70 flags and all four VERTEX records.
validation.fixturePolicy: The DWG/DXF were generated and retained only under the system temporary directory.

interpretation: The DXF writer emitted group 70 value 9 (closed bit plus 3D bit), consistent with Autodesk's documented POLYLINE flags. The selected FreeCAD route creates an open three-edge shape for this closed entity. Do not alter correctly emitted group-70 data or promote closed 3D POLYLINE consumer support on this evidence.
supportClaimEffect: Identifies a bounded downstream consumer semantic gap; no library support claim is promoted.
